source_evidence:
User exact "Ok great. **speak with the scholarly fund's representative about the 1,200 gp opportunity, AND ask Edric to arrange an audience with Lord Severin before evening**" at Day289 ~15:35 NIGHTGLASS HALL records room, following accepted recovery PLAY-REC-D289-V-NIGHTGLASS-FURTHER-ARCHIVE-REVIEW-FUND-LEAD-001. This user directive authorizes two linked in-world conversations/meeting coordination and ordinary household time passage, NOT automatic V acceptance of the scholarly commission, promise of field exploration, contractual ownership transfer or acceptance of Severin demands, coin/attunement spending, oath, or binding subordination. 
Original precommitted DM Nightglass estate/ancestry "Hall/source contract" fixed independent scholarly recovery fund with TOTAL1200gp RESERVED for potentially commissioned *usable evidence*: 400gp authenticated comparison/copies of Hall original recovery/cargo packing and INDEPENDENT Orsaven survey, and 800gp for corroborated site/crossing documentation respecting any living resident's lawful access and property. Edric can introduce a LOCAL FUND REPRESENTATIVE. The exact person name wasn't previously defined, so during first actual introduction name the independent scholarly fund commissioning agent CORIS TALLEN (adult woman, dark traveling coat, leather document case; no assumed noble status or prior relation to any earlier Tallen). She is an agent of SEPARATE scholarly funds, not an employee of House Severin or any Vaishnavi estate. Independent motive: authentic evidence and adequate professional documentation, not confirming V's family story regardless of fact. Local representative is reachable via ordinary Nightglass household runner and enters Hall at ~Day28916:20, after Edric sends inquiries at~15:40. This is already-known open willingness to talk with possible patron and ordinary professional work, no random gating or contrived unavailable bureaucratic errand. She greets V, Mara and Cirren, presents actual PROPOSED commission terms as verbally quoted+draft schedule: first independently verifiable historical documentary set must actually compare House Hall recovery record/carrier mark to separate physical ORSAVEN field-book text and supply usable/source-attributed copies for up to 400gp upon acceptance of work AND satisfactory delivery; second 800gp for actual field record identifying a corroborated crossing/site and genuine historically relevant physical features without denying present residents' established access, also payable only upon satisfactory post-commissioned evidence delivery. Two tranches can be independent: inability/refusal to explore does not erase an otherwise earned documentary comparison payment, and no reward is owed today. No nonrefundable deposit, automatic advance, automatic exclusive rights to physical originals, title transfer, compulsory antiquities surrender or grant of legal salvage ownership; ownership/custody of all old Hall originals remains Hall. No new requirement that V obtain antiquity via theft, sacrifice resident rights or solve ancient genealogy. Coris explicitly says evidence remains valuable regardless whether it proves/disproves V's ancestry. Cirren independently checks that legitimacy/genealogy success is NOT a prerequisite for site/document payout; she truthfully confirms. Mara appreciates fair evidentiary condition; Fenar remains with group without coerced speech. No agreement signed/accepted, representative promises no payment until satisfactory deliverables after real V acceptance of commission. Proposed terms remain available at Hall via Coris/Edric for V choice, no arbitrary immediate expiration date or forced decision while Lord Severin expects him. Orsaven copy REQUEST independently drafted Day289~14:20 remains in Hall outgoing queue; no same-afternoon delivery of that remote copy or dispatch/reply established. 
Edric also independently follows through user's second request by sending a legitimate household messenger to resident LORD SEVERIN with name of prior acquaintance V and summary of previous proposal. The Lord is free to choose; recognizes V from prior Hall meeting, has already been notified of arrival since ~13:05, is not shown busy with an unsupplied emergency. He willingly agrees to REAL AUDIENCE before evening today, conveys acceptance via staff by ~16:35 and invites V+Mara+Cirren+Fenar to his private sitting room by~16:50. Edric leads them to Hall's quieter wing, ordinary low fire/grounds windows, no need for fresh social DC merely to have a courteous audience, no invented guard fee, no House oath. Severin politely acknowledges V's past visit, interests in heart's history, and recent earned modern holdings/alliances. He hears enough detail from Edric to know V's proposal for SEVERIN retention of lawful property, family name, modern rights/independence while a restored voluntary allegiance beneath senior House VAISHNAVI banner, conditional real legal/historical standing, without V claiming to own Nightglass or coercing fealty. Lord does NOT already accept merger, vassalage, estate transfer, rent tribute or marriage/title; he independently asks V in person what he would EXPECT House Severin to contribute and what reciprocal protection/status/obligations V offers. This is a legitimate consequential question for USER-controlled V to answer, not the DM inventing V's political deal or unchosen military/financial promises. Edric and party remain physically in Lord's sitting room as audience BEGINS, no other private chamber explored, no relic review or new heart clue. Day289 ~16:50, before evening, all user dual requests completed at appropriate scope: fund representative physically met and presented genuine concrete offer; Lord Severin physical audience obtained and political discussion ready. 
Current same party stats V48/48 HP AC19 HD7/7 Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 PastLife3/3 PsiRecovery1/1 ActionSurge1/1 SecondWind1/1 freeWhispers1/1, attuned worn Cloak of Protection and physically carried attuned Luckstone2/3 slots with +1 to checks/saves and initiative, no added AC/attack; Fenar59/59HP HD6/6 Rage4/4 inactive Shift3/3 MP6/6 CLIMB40; Cirren51/51 full spells/CD2, Mara healthy, V-owned four horses and coach sound in Hall courtyard with basic water but NO new stabling/feed/lodging booked. V purse329gp1sp6cp, packed rations21 person-days/feed28 animal-days, sealed Pixie Dust1, weighted LongRest5/6, no resource/recovery roll, no new night/meal. V original Kestrel station directive/2 unconsented experimental orders/transfer ledger/two contradictory clinical folios and signed injury packet/mage ordinary pouch all remain V-held and undisclosed to Hall NPCs, Mara Neri interview notes and Hall comparison working notes, Fenar padded six sealed reagents and silver-fitted measuring instrument retained. Sedgecross11 freed patients remain in already prepaid 14-night civilian care after Blackthorn offer actually directly given in person before party departure; no new patient relocation news. Rethwyn-Vaishnavi private Day233 signed compact original still in Cirren's document case, no publicly registered Crown wedding/legal marriage is established. NEXT V responds about practical alliance duties and mutual protections to Lord Severin, may also choose to return to sign/refuse/negotiate proposed scholarly fund commission separately.
